quest.title: Venti's Plan
quest.description: Stopped at last, Venti explained that he had tried and failed to cleanse Dvalin's curse during their previous meeting. Now, he has been forced to rely on the Holy Lyre der Himmel's power if he is to restore Dvalin.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x275, Mora x5975, Character EXP x3125, Fine Enhancement Ore x5

talks.objective: Go to the Cathedral with Venti

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this... "Holy Lyre der Himmel" is...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: One of the most treasured items in Mondstadt. It's the lyre that Barbatos used to play.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: With it, perhaps I can help Dvalin draw his gentle nature back out of this nightmare he's going through.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Will it really stop Stormterror from causing more damage?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Of course. I'm the best bard in the world.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: There's not a single song I do not know, no matter if it's from the past, present, or future.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Look me in the eyes. Do you not find me trustworthy?

choices.text: ...just what is that in your eyes!?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Hahaha, that one doesn't work on a bard.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So how can we get the Holy Lyre?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: It's said that it's enshrined deep within the Cathedral, somewhere safe.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I'll go take a look around. You can come if you want.

choices.text: Look into my eyes. What are you hiding?
The color of your eyes is like the sky in my hometown.

talks.objective: See how Venti borrows the Holy Lyre

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Let me handle this...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hello there, Sister.

dialogues.speaker: Gotelinde
dialogues.text: May the Anemo God bless you, young bard. How can I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Actually, I know a secret that can save Mondstadt from its current predicament.

dialogues.speaker: Gotelinde
dialogues.text: Oh, what a blessing from the God of Anemo!

dialogues.speaker: Gotelinde
dialogues.text: But you should report that to the Knights of Favonius. Why have you come to me?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hahaha, because you, dear sister, are able to help!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I'd like to borrow... the Holy Lyre. With it, I'll be able to help Stormterror—

dialogues.speaker: Gotelinde
dialogues.text: Please see yourselves out.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: What?

dialogues.speaker: Gotelinde
dialogues.text: It's a vicious dragon indeed, but once the Acting Grand Master makes up her mind, nothing can stand in the Knights' way.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: That's simply not acceptable. Wouldn't Stormterror end up getting killed that way?

dialogues.speaker: Gotelinde
dialogues.text: That foolish beast betrayed the winds. Not even the God of Anemo themselves would forgive it!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Wow...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Please, I beg of you!

dialogues.speaker: Gotelinde
dialogues.text: I'm afraid not, little bard.

dialogues.speaker: Gotelinde
dialogues.text: (Strange... Somehow I feel so bad rejecting this sweet child...)

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Then... I guess I'm left with no other choice.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I cannot hide anymore!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: My disciples, rejoice! Behold, the <color=#00E1FFFF>God of Anemo, Barbatos</color> has descended!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Shocked, aren't you? Don't you just want to cry out and rejoice? How does it feel to finally meet the god you've been serving?

dialogues.speaker: Gotelinde
dialogues.text: If there's nothing else, I'll be going back to handle the Cathedral's paperwork now.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Wait—

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Eh? She didn't even bat an eyelid.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: But, I have at least learned what I wanted to know.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: She didn't deny that the Cathedral is enshrining the Holy Lyre.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #Now, {NICKNAME}, since you're the hotshot of the Knights of Favonius...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Maybe you can give it a shot.

dialogues.speaker: Gotelinde
dialogues.text: Barbatos bless you.

response.speaker: Gotelinde
response.text: Ah, it's you! The newcomer of the Knights of Favonius, aren't you?

response.speaker: Gotelinde
response.text: So what brings you here? Tasks from the Acting Grand Master?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yes, actually. The Knights of Favonius would like to borrow the Holy Lyre...

response.speaker: Gotelinde
response.text: Not that I don't trust you. It's just that a suspicious bard came looking to borrow the Holy Lyre as well.

response.speaker: Gotelinde
response.text: He's full of nonsense and even called himself Barbatos. He must be up to something.

response.speaker: Gotelinde
response.text: There are regulations in place for the use of the Holy Lyre. Currently, it's only used in Ludi Harpastum.

response.speaker: Gotelinde
response.text: Signed documents from the Grand Master, Seneschal, and Community Representative are all required.

response.speaker: Gotelinde
response.text: So, may I see the document from the Knights of Favonius?

choices.text: The Grand Master didn't mention it...

response.speaker: Gotelinde
response.text: A signed document is required. Without it, there's not much I can do.

response.speaker: Gotelinde
response.text: Now, if you'll excuse me. I really am quite busy as of late.

choices.text: I'm sorry, I forgot to bring it here.
Paimon ate it on our way here.
#I am the Honorary Knight of Favonius, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Gotelinde
response.text: I know you. You and Amber saved Mondstadt that day.

dialogues.speaker: Gotelinde
dialogues.text: The Church has been a mess recently, and the Seneschal is not here... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Otto
dialogues.text: Man, this stinks. Having to stand around here all <color=#00E1FFFF>day</color> long, having to guard this entrance.\nHey! Don't move! You can't go down there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems we're gonna have to wait until <color=#00E1FFFF>nightfall</color> to sneak in...
